## At a Glance · Wednesday, October 14, 2026
**IDENTITY: Only God's opinion of you sticks.**

## 4 · Only God's Opinion of You Matters
*A five-second pause*
**Let God's view of you outrank every loud opinion.**

### Pressure
If you are not sure who you are, stress finds an open door.

> You are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. Matthew 5:14 KJV

### Secure
Other people's opinions lose the right to define you.

> And be not conformed to this world. Romans 12:2 KJV

Today, write one sentence about who God says you are.
**God's opinion of you is still the one that sticks.**
:::callout
**VERSE**
*Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.* Matthew 5:14 KJV
:::
